description: This file defines a PHP class SugarWebServiceImplv2_1 that extends a base SOAP web service implementation for SuiteCRM, specifically implementing the 'get_entry_list' method to retrieve a list of beans. It includes licensing information, class documentation, and method-specific logic for processing relationship data.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv2_1
classes.description: Implementation class for SuiteCRM REST services, extending SugarWebServiceImpl and overriding the get_entry_list method.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries (beans) from the specified module, processes relationship list data for output formatting, and returns the result.
